customer_name.title: Customer name
customer_name.description: sync_customer, optional. Name for the new Metronome customer.

stripe_price_id.title: Stripe price ID
stripe_price_id.description: sync_contract and credit_invoice. The subscription's current price; the Metronome package with this alias is used.

subscription_start.title: Subscription start
subscription_start.description: sync_contract. Subscription start date (Unix seconds or RFC 3339).

invoice_amount_paid.title: Invoice amount paid (cents)
invoice_amount_paid.description: credit_invoice. Becomes the credit amount, e.g. 2000 for $20.

period_start.title: Service period start
period_start.description: credit_invoice. The first line item's period start (Unix seconds or RFC 3339).

period_end.title: Service period end
period_end.description: credit_invoice. The first line item's period end (Unix seconds or RFC 3339).

credit_product_id.title: Metronome credit product ID
credit_product_id.description: credit_invoice. UUID of a FIXED Metronome product, e.g. Prepaid Credits.
